title: The Latest Crier for Feb 10, 2026
items:
Cards From The Heart

Stop by the Maytag Atrium on Feburary 12, from 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM to create a heartfelt Valentine’s card for a friend or loved one. Decorate a cute card and attach your favorite candy for the perfect sweet surprise. A quick, fun way to spread the love this Valentine’s Day!

ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Ash Wednesday Service

On Wednesday, February 18, we will be hosting an Ash Wednesday Service in the Upper Chapel. Faculty, staff, & students are welcome to join as we prepare for the season of Lent! Two short services will be held in the Upper Chapel at 11:00 am & 12:00 pm with lunch available in between services & following the 12:00 pm service. All are welcome!

Want to be added to the Lent Devo list?!

Lent Season is almost here! We will be sending daily email devotionals written by students, faculty, & staff during the weeks leading up to Easter. If you would like to be put on the email list to receive daily devos, please email flugw@central.edu to be added.

ARE YOU CENTRAL'S NEXT STUDENT BODY PRESIDENT?

Calling all dedicated and passionate current Sophomores and Juniors!! 
Student Body president applications are OPEN NOW! 

Find the application in your Central email or under MyCentral > Student Life > Student Senate. Applications must be printed and submitted to the Student Development office by February 11th at NOON!

WHO'S GOT YOUR VOTE?

You're invited to the STUDENT BODY PRESIDENTIAL FORUM! 
Thurs Feb 12th / 8pm / VSC 180 

- Meet the candidates 

- Hear their ideas 

- Ask questions 

- Make your vote count!

Paid Student Leader Positions for Fall 2026

Lead. Serve. Get Paid. Apply now for paid student leader positions for Fall 2026 : CAB | RA | SOS Make an impact on campus and grow your leadership skills. Apply by March 1! Link to Apply: https://app.joinhandshake.com/e/1010657/jobs

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Social Media Guidelines

The Central College Communications Office wanted to remind everyone of the social media guidelines: 
Contact the Communications Office before creating any account for a department, office, organization or club. 

All affiliated accounts represent Central’s brand. 

Account owners must share usernames and passwords when graduating or stepping away. Provide access to your department supervisor or the Communications Office ( muurm@central.edu ). 

Accounts inactive for six consecutive months may be deleted. 

View our full brand guide: https://brand.central.edu/social-media/

Friday Night Central Wrestling Meet | FREE Popcorn for Students

Join us, Friday, February 13th at 5PM for the Central Wrestling Last Chance Invitational meet. Central students get free popcorn! Come on out and bring your Dutch Spirit!!
